posts.name: Kratos13
posts.cooked:
So from the fireside chat rulings:

Suppose Shocking Animation goes next to an Ongoing card due to Caspit’s Playground, then Caspit's Playground leaves play. The effects of Shocking Animation no longer apply to the card, since it's no longer an equipment card. Shocking Animation just hangs out and looks sad.

So, what happens when Caspit's Playground comes into play again?  Easy example: Caspit is in play. Shocking Animation is played next to an ongoing. Entry point covers Caspit. Caspit no longer applies.  Entry point is destroyed, Caspit is back again.

By rationale of the fireside ruling, should Shocking Animation apply again?  It is still next to the ongoing according to the lightning bolt details.  FYI in the video game, Shocking Animation is not re-applied.

Edit: Ok just proceed with my turn in the video game.  Shocking Animation appears to apply because it deals the 2 damage to everyone.  But ongoing does not have HP (i.e. is not a target). Intentional?
